en: The postcard features three black-and-white photographs: an elegant villa with a fence and trees, a wooden pavilion or gazebo with decorative elements, and a large, ornate wooden gate with a mountain landscape in the background. The images are labeled with Romanian text. The card has a clear vintage look, with printed text on the left and bottom indicating the publisher and location.
